entities.name: Alajn
entities.description: Valkyrie reaper of Starnheim who kills deserters and sends them to Istfell.

entities.name: Njala
entities.description: Alajn's paired sister, a shepherd valkyrie.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: New leader of the Tuskeri warriors watched by the valkyries.

entities.name: Tover Giants-Blood
entities.description: Giant Kannah warrior defeated by Arni in an honor duel.

events.summary: Arni leads the Tuskeri against Skelle raiders and quickly overwhelms them.
events.quote: Despite being outnumbered, the Tuskeri displayed remarkable bravery and combat prowess, quickly overwhelming their foes.

events.summary: Arni subdues a hellkite using bravery and clever tactics.
events.quote: Arni managed to subdue it using a combination of bravery and clever tactics.

events.summary: Arni defeats Tover Giants-Blood in an honor duel, breaking a bear hug with a headbutt.
events.quote: Arni's cunning and determination allowed him to break free with a headbutt and ultimately defeat the giant human.

relations.quote: She has a paired sister named Njala , who serves as a shepherd.
